references.text: The preceding context describing the offer of peace before a siege, which stands in contrast to the situation where the city refuses peace
Joshua besieged and captured cities that did not make peace with Israel, in accordance with this law
Saul besieged Jabesh-Gilead, an example of military siege in practice
David besieged Rabbah, a practical application of siege tactics against an enemy city
Joab besieged Abel-Beth-Maacah, an example of besieging a city that did not surrender peacefully
Ben-Hadad besieged Samaria, showing the consequences of war when peace is not achieved
Israel offered peace to Sihon, but he refused and went to war, resulting in his defeat
